reviewMethod: Every original PNG was opened individually with view_image at original resolution. File hashing and native pass status were not used as substitutes for visual inspection.

environment.fonts: Recorded fontconfig family/style/version/path catalog in linux-environment.txt; no cross-platform pixel comparison.

binding.siteBuild: Not present in package-scoped candidate inputs; no site build fingerprint invented.

findings.defaultContextRegression: Not reproduced in this candidate. Public nested demo visibly shows md3/dark, shadcn/light, apple/dark and md3/dark with en-US/large/compact; the exact native eight-axis assertions exercise the public consumer path. Core summaries display actual non-default design/mode/size/density; the old silent md3/light/medium/standard fallback would not satisfy these summaries/assertions.
findings.documents: All 18 cross-document interaction images visibly show the final draft '跨文档保留 2 · Draft through actual input' in outer, iframe and Shadow inputs with corresponding non-default child summaries/surfaces; exact eight-axis values, brand/radius/nonce and DOM identity are separately asserted.
findings.portal: Every captured portal scene visibly retains the current design/mode/size/density and shared real draft in its detached content.
findings.zoom: All six real 200% images show full physical viewport dimensions, correctly inherited Portal summaries and visible '200% draft'. No former half-width crop or insertion-caret vertical stripe was observed; offscreen inherited content is not approved as fully viewed.

limitations: Approval is limited to the actual visible area of these 366 original PNGs and the exact candidate fingerprints. It does not establish a pixel baseline, mark design coverage verified, or complete the full library.

Chromium core covers 6 design/mode configurations × 3 sizes × 3 densities × 4 states = 216. Firefox and WebKit each cover the declared medium/standard default, portal and focus-visible subset (18), not the full Chromium Cartesian product.
All 18 inventory images show only the default cross-document demo viewport. They do not replace state/size interaction review.
Single images show the final real input value; temporal DOM identity and draft retention across all configuration changes are evidenced by native Playwright assertions, not inferred from static PNGs.

Eight axes are checked natively. Design/mode/size/density/locale/direction summaries and actual surfaces/brand/focus are visible. Nonce and exact CSS/DOM inheritance cannot be approved from pixels; they are supported by exact JSON, attributes, computed styles and style nonce assertions. This is not a full CSP-policy or accessibility audit.
The hasTouch environment performs real text input/configuration switching with hasTouch enabled; it does not execute a separate tap/pan gesture. No tap/pan acceptance is claimed.
Reduced-motion images exercise the browser media condition for these static boundaries, not continuous-animation acceptance for the rest of the library.

320px screenshots wrap the diagnostic summaries; long single-line input text is partly outside the native input viewport. Full input value and retention are asserted. No page overflow was observed or permitted by the native test.
Real 200% Chromium uses chrome.tabs.setZoom=2, viewport:null and unchanged CSS zoom/outer dimensions. PNGs are full current physical viewport 1280×813, not full-page or all offscreen content.

Zoom carets are hidden only during capture (including iframe/open Shadow roots) and restored afterward; focus and animations remain live. The scoped native-protocol compatibility capture is an existing documented framework exception, not a claimed pure Page screenshot path.
The iframe fixed-height area below its actual styled boundary is empty host document space. RTL diagnostic JSON can wrap around the nonce hyphen/braces; exact parsed values are separately asserted.
Rendering driver strings are recorded verbatim. WebKit reporting 'Apple GPU' does not establish physical Apple hardware.

Only the 25 current ConfigProvider source files plus the two inspected shared capture files were physically matched to candidate source entries during this review. No claim that every current repository file still matches the candidate is made.
No new browser run, product/source modification, baseline update, verified/lifecycle update or rewrite of original images/native reports was performed by this review.
